title: G2b fix round 1: repo-map trimming spreads cuts across modules so daemon.py and spawn.py keep their public functions; the merge gate never skips on an ambient env var (review T-0295)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain dd8ab79 "T-0267 add repository map generator" in git log; never drop it.
Review T-0295 on T-0267: (high) repomap.build's budget trim sorts candidates by (rank, module, symbol) and pops from the front, so it empties whole modules in rank-then-alphabetical order; on this repo daemon.py and spawn.py sections end up with only their docstring, failing acceptance 3 (daemon.py, bus.py and spawn.py must list their public functions); the three-module fixture is too small to expose it. (med) merge.py guards the entire tests-green invocation with `if not os.environ.get(IN_TESTS_GREEN)`, so any process with ORCH_TESTS_GREEN in its environment skips the merge gate and fast-forwards unverified code; the gate is the merge bar and must never be skippable by an ambient variable.
Change:
1. repomap.build: trim round-robin across modules by removing the lowest-value symbol from the module that currently has the most symbols (ties by lower rank), never removing a module's last 3 public symbols while any module still has more than 3; module order and header unchanged. Test with a fixture of four modules where two have 12 symbols each and the budget forces cuts: every module keeps at least 3 symbols and the two big modules lose symbols first. Verify on this repo that `orchestrator repomap --stdout` lists at least 3 functions each for daemon.py, bus.py and spawn.py under 4,000 chars.
2. merge.merge: the tests-green gate always runs; remove the environment-based skip of the gate. Only the repo-map refresh may be skipped, and only when merge() is called with an explicit keyword refresh_repomap=False or ORCH_ROOT has no orchestrator/repomap.py. If the recursion the first thread saw (test_merge's real-repo merges re-running the suite) reappears, fix its cause explicitly: the nested gate must run inside the scratch repo only (cwd and ORCH_ROOT of the scratch repo, whose tests are tiny), never against this repo; document the mechanism in a comment. Test: test_merge_gate_runs_even_with_marker_env (ORCH_TESTS_GREEN set in os.environ, merge still invokes the gate, asserted through a monkeypatched subprocess.run).
3. Keep tests/test_repomap.py and tests/test_merge.py green; final message reports the repomap --stdout size and the per-module function counts for daemon, bus and spawn.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows dd8ab79 below your commit
tests/test_repomap.py::test_trim_spreads_across_modules passes and the three T-0267 repomap tests still pass
uv run orchestrator repomap --stdout prints under 4,000 chars with at least 3 functions each for daemon.py, bus.py and spawn.py (counts in the final message)
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree within 10 minutes
